panel.right: Show or hide the context panel

vibe.toggle: Open or close the Vibe panel

focus.left: Move to the cell on the left
focus.right: Move to the cell on the right

zoom.previous: Previous conversation in the zoomed cell
zoom.next: Next conversation in the zoomed cell

panel.hide: Show or hide the side panel
panel.pin: Pin the side panel for this conversation

vibe.device: Switch which machines the panel shows
vibe.attention: Jump to the next conversation that needs you
vibe.add: Add a conversation to the panel
vibe.remove: Remove the selected conversation from the panel

page.hint: Shortcuts work anywhere in the app.
page.terminalBlocked: Ignored while the terminal has focus: this key belongs to the shell
page.levels: {{coarse}} steps between workspaces and conversations; {{fine}} steps through every conversation; inside one, {{questions}} jumps between questions. Changes apply immediately.
page.scopedVibe: Only while the Vibe panel is open; inside it these keys may replace the ones above.
page.multiKey: These keys are fixed for now.

recorder.hint: Esc to cancel, Backspace to remove

fixed.title: Fixed keys
fixed.description: These keep their meaning everywhere and cannot be changed.
fixed.escape: Close a dialog, or reject a request
fixed.transcript: Jump to the previous / next question
